Priya Nair: Weekly account pulse for Driftly — quick snapshot (tokens + throughput, WoW / QoQ).
Priya Nair: TL;DR: tokens/day 1.2M (WoW +12%, QoQ +48%), p50 latency 140ms (WoW +47ms), 5xx error rate 0.4% (was 0.05%). Spend this billing week ~$4.2k (WoW +18%). Renewal health: medium risk — onboarding stalled on streaming integration.
Eli Torres: Thanks — where are the 5xxs originating? runtime timeouts or model OOMs?
Priya Nair: Mostly timeouts at the runtime layer during peak bursts (11:30–12:30 PT). A few OOMs on larger context requests (~2% of errors).
Sam Chen: Can you paste the error snippet? quick grep will help.
Priya Nair: Here are the top traces (sanitized):
```
2026-03-18T11:35:12Z ERROR request_id=abc123 runtime_timeout route=/v1/generate latency=12000ms status=504
2026-03-18T11:35:18Z ERROR request_id=def456 model=gpt-like-7b oom=true ctx_len=8192
```
Maya Patel: Noted. Their typical payloads spike mid-day because of batch backfills + interactive UI tests. That explains the batching pressure.
Sam Chen: Two quick levers: reduce default max_tokens for interactive route to 256 and enable prefix KV cache for onboarding flows. Suggest config: 
```json
{"route":"/v1/chat","max_tokens":256,"kv_cache":true,"batch_size_target":8}
```
Sam Chen: That should drop average tokens per call and lower tail latency.
Eli Torres: Also consider transient capacity bump for their Dedicated pool during local peak window (noon). 1–2 extra GPUs for 6 hours should flatten the 5xxs.
Priya Nair: Good call. Cost impact estimate: +$450/week for bump vs current excess spend from retries ~ $700/week.
cs-bot: [alert] Driftly peak latency spike detected (11:20–12:45 PT), 95th p95=1.8s, triggered runbook cs/high-latency.
Maya Patel: I'll run a quick enablement session with their engs Thurs 9am PT to walk KV cache + batching. I'll also share a lightweight sample prompt to reduce token churn.
Priya Nair: Action items:
- Maya: schedule and run enablement (Thu 09:00 PT) — share sample prompts + code snippets.
- Sam: push route config change to limit interactive max_tokens and enable kv_cache (test in staging first).
- Eli: propose dedicated bump and exact hours, I'll review procurement.
Priya Nair: Renewal note: flag as "monitoring" — positive QoQ growth but short-term reliability concerns + onboarding friction. Recommend outreach 2 weeks before renewal with a health remediation update.
Eli Torres: +1 on outreach. Also request logs export for the 11:30–12:30 window to perf team.
Priya Nair: Uploaded the annotated billing snapshot and token breakdown to the Driftly CS folder. Will follow-up after enablement with updated metrics.
Maya Patel: :thumbsup: I'll own the enablement and send meeting invite.
Sam Chen: Will prepare the staging rollout for the config change and post results here.
Priya Nair: Thanks team — closing this thread. Will post a follow-up in 48–72h with updated WoW numbers. :sparkles:
